screens.note: the CRT screen object has its own UV 0..1 over the whole glass; Unity puts the camera picture there (render texture) in M_Kit_Screen_On; T_Kit_Screen_On (CAM 1, the barrier) and T_Kit_Screen_On_Gate (CAM 2, the gate) are stand-in CCTV pictures for the previews

notes.lbl_switch: NETZ mark at -45 deg (10:30), BATTERIE at +45 deg (1:30) from 12 o'clock about the plate point (0.5, 38/64 from the top); the handle turns 90 clockwise
notes.lbl_monitor: knob centres at u 0.410 (CONTRAST), 0.676 (BRIGHT), 0.895 (POWER) of the strip, label row v 0.72, index marks v 0.38
notes.phone_dial: holes at radius 16.6 / 24 of the half width, digit d at 60 - (d - 1) * 30 deg clockwise from 12 o'clock (1 at 2 o'clock, 0 at 5 o'clock); the stop at ~110 deg
notes.l_beacon: cylindrical: u round the dome, v up from the rim; the mirror band at u 0.5
